race.comment: Looks a lovely race for the resuming I AM ARIA (3) who showed plenty of ability at two, second on debut in the Blue Diamond Preview, then third in the Prelude behind Streisand and Chayan which is excellent form. Perhaps it was the heavy ground or going up against a maiden with such good form because half the field and nearly all of the dangers have scratched, leaving her prohibitively short in betting. NOVAMIRA (5) is now the danger on debut for the Waller yard. She's by Lucky Vega out of G1 winner Unforgotten who has jumped out well enough and warrants respect. SILENT DEVOTION (10) resumes having run a solid third on debut last time in. She can improve off that and figure. SKY WYTCH (11) next best on debut.
